reserveReview.rationale: Issuer factsheet dated August 31, 2026 reports commercial paper 44.5%, certificates of deposit 31.3%, time deposits 17.5% and cash 6.7% of total net assets, summing to 100% without normalization. It reports 52 positions and USD 46m whole-fund size, WAM 39 days and WAL 67 days. These averages are not maximum tenor. The exact Class 1 ACC identity is FILQ-A, ISIN KYG3R61G1088; Class 1 DIST is a separate claim. The Moody's Aaa-mf fund assessment is explicitly not a credit rating. Direct PDF access returned 403; the issuer document was recovered through its text mirror at 2026-10-09T11:39:28Z. Its August 31 portfolio date, not the mirror's October 9 HTTP timestamp or this review date, governs freshness. The observation is historical and outside the ordinary 31+7-day composition window on October 9; it supplies no current composition or independent token-to-fund financial assurance.
